evals.prompt: How do I get the pKa of aspirin with Rowan?
evals.expected_output: Shows submitting a Rowan pKa workflow with the SMILES string (bare string accepted for pKa), then calling result() to get typed results. Notes that the API key must be set (ROWAN_API_KEY or rowan.api_key) and that microscopic pKa suits a single ionizable group.

evals.prompt: I have 40 analogues of my kinase lead in analogs.csv (SMILES column) and a prepared receptor, kinase.pdb, with a co-crystal ligand as reference. I tried passing the SMILES strings straight into the analogue docking workflow and got a ValueError before submission. Fix this and run the whole series on Rowan, then pull out the best pose and score for each.
evals.expected_output: Explains that analogue docking requires rowan.Molecule.from_smiles (or an RDKit Mol), not bare strings, which is the cause of the ValueError. Uploads the protein, builds the molecule list, submits as a batch with a reference ligand, then polls or streams results. Reads best_pose and scores through typed properties, falling back to .data.

evals.prompt: I need to know how my carboxylic acid/amine drug candidate will be charged across pH 0-14, and whether it will cross membranes and how soluble it is at pH 7.4. I don't want to set up any local compute. How would I do that programmatically for a few hundred compounds?
evals.expected_output: Recommends cloud-based macropKa rather than single microscopic pKa because of multiple coupled ionizable groups and pH-dependent behavior. Chains it to permeability and solubility, using batch submission with projects/folders and optional webhooks. Mentions credit and cost considerations and that these workflows accept SMILES strings.

evals.prompt: Run DiffDock-L on my protein structure complex.pdb and ligands.sdf, then explain how to interpret the confidence scores for the top poses.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a DiffDock task, not Rowan. Answer should use the diffdock skill: run DiffDock-L locally on the PDB and SDF, and interpret confidence scores, noting they are not binding affinities.

evals.prompt: I want to run AlphaFold and Boltz structure predictions through the Tamarind Bio REST API for my binder design project. Show me how to submit the jobs.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a Tamarind Bio platform task, not Rowan. Answer should use the tamarind skill and describe submitting jobs via the Tamarind REST API or MCP server.
